source.prompt: Reconstruct the missing implementation files listed in targetScope. Preserve the following behavior contract. S03 核验 write/edit/apply_patch 的工作区外写入边界：非法来源的写必须无副作用修改，合法（trusted/operator）外写保留原语义，路径逃逸（父目录/绝对/别名/大小写）被拒且文件不变；只核实既有单一边界，不新建第二套策略。
commands: pnpm --dir openclaw_runtime exec node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run src/agents/workspace-external-write-provenance-policy.test.ts src/agents/agent-tools.workspace-boundary.test.ts src/agents/apply-patch-consistency.test.ts src/agents/sessions/tools/write.test.ts src/agents/sessions/tools/edit.test.ts --maxWorkers=1
